title: Open the ChineseEVs feed and start a post detail view
description: This verifies that a user can browse the ChineseEVs feed and open a post detail view that shows the focus post and related responses panel.
category: Research feed and focus-post detail viewing

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs
Verify the research feed is displayed
Open a post detail view from the feed
Verify the focus post detail layout is displayed
Verify the related responses panel is displayed

title: Open the linked post from a related card body
description: This verifies that clicking the body or top strip of a related card opens the linked post detail view instead of only toggling inline interactions.
category: Related-card topic grouping and navigation guards

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click the top strip of a related card
Verify the linked post detail view opens
Verify the focus post content changes to the linked post

title: Reveal a below-fold highlight from a related card
description: This verifies that hovering a related card reveals a below-fold linked region in the focus post and shows the expanded read state.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a related card whose linked region is below the fold
Wait for the hover state to settle
Verify the focus post expands to reveal the linked highlight
Verify an expanded read state is visible

title: Open a selected post detail view directly
description: This verifies that a user can open the post detail route and inspect both the focus post and the related-stacks panel.
category: Research feed and focus-post detail viewing

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Verify the focus post content is displayed
Verify the related-stacks aside panel is displayed

title: Browse the feed and open a post detail view
description: This verifies that the ChineseEVs feed loads and a user can open a post detail view from it.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs
Open a post card from the feed
Verify the post detail view opens
Verify the feed content is replaced by the selected post view

title: Click a related card body to open its linked detail view
description: This verifies that clicking the card body or top strip navigates to the linked post detail view instead of triggering the in-card interaction controls.
category: Research feed and focus-post detail viewing

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click the body or top strip of a related card
Verify the linked post detail view is displayed
Verify the related panel remains available in the detail view

title: Hover a related card to highlight linked focus regions
description: This verifies that hovering a related card cross-highlights all linked focus regions in the detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a related card and allow the highlight state to settle
Verify linked focus regions are highlighted
Verify the highlight uses a faint category color

title: Group related responses by clicking a highlighted span
description: This verifies that clicking a highlighted span on a related card groups the related panel by that topic and shows the grouping pill.
category: Related-card topic grouping and navigation guards

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a highlighted span on a related card
Verify the related panel groups responses by the selected topic
Verify a grouped-by pill is visible

title: Click a highlighted focus span to filter related responses
description: This verifies that clicking a highlighted span in the focus post narrows the related panel to matching posts and keeps the selected span visually active.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a highlighted span in the focus post
Verify the related panel is narrowed to linked posts
Verify the selected focus span remains visually active

title: Hover a linked span to emphasize one focus region more strongly
description: This verifies that hovering a specific span within a related card gives that linked focus region a stronger highlight than the broader card hover state.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a specific span within a related card and allow the highlight state to settle
Verify one linked focus region is highlighted more strongly
Verify the emphasized span uses a lighter pastel shade

title: Clear topic grouping by clicking the same highlighted span again
description: This verifies that clicking the same highlighted span again removes the grouping and restores the prior related-panel arrangement.
category: Related-card topic grouping and navigation guards

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a highlighted span on a related card
Click the same highlighted span again
Verify the related panel returns to its prior arrangement
Verify the grouped-by pill is no longer visible

title: Click the same focus span again to clear the filter
description: This verifies that clicking the active highlighted span again restores the related panel to its previous unfiltered state.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a highlighted span in the focus post
Click the same highlighted span again
Verify the related panel returns to its unfiltered state

title: Collapse the focus post after hover ends
description: This verifies that the focus post returns to its collapsed read state after hovering a below-fold related card ends.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a related card whose linked region is below the fold
Wait for the hover state to settle
Move the cursor away from the related card
Verify the focus post collapses back to the shorter read state
Verify the expanded highlight reveal is no longer shown

title: Group by topic from a relation tag without navigating away
description: This verifies that clicking a relation category tag groups the related panel by topic while the current detail view stays in place.
category: Related-card topic grouping and navigation guards

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a relation category tag on a related card
Verify the related panel groups by the selected topic
Verify the current detail view remains open

title: Use the feed to return to browsing related posts
description: This verifies that the feed view remains usable for reviewing post cards and related responses after starting from the ChineseEVs experience.
category: Research feed and focus-post detail viewing

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs
Verify post cards are displayed
Verify the related responses aside panel is displayed

title: Hover a below-fold related card to auto-reveal the focus content
description: This verifies that hovering a related card whose linked region is below the fold automatically expands the post and collapses it when hover ends.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a related card whose linked region is below the fold and allow the highlight state to settle
Verify the focus post auto-expands to reveal the linked region
Move the pointer away from the related card
Verify the focus post collapses back

title: Preserve a manual expansion during hover reveal
description: This verifies that manually expanding the post keeps the expanded state available when a below-fold related card is hovered.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Manually expand the focus post
Hover a related card whose linked region is below the fold
Wait for the hover state to settle
Verify the focus post remains expanded while the highlight is revealed
Verify the expanded read state is still visible

title: Click a related span to group the panel by topic without navigating away
description: This verifies that clicking a highlighted span or relation tag on a related card groups the related panel by topic and keeps the user on the same detail view.
category: Research feed and focus-post detail viewing

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a highlighted span or relation tag on a related card
Verify the related panel is grouped by topic
Verify a grouped by pill is displayed

title: Hover a linked span to show faux-bold emphasis without reflow
description: This verifies that the emphasized sub-span renders with text-shadow while the font weight remains visually stable.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a specific span within a related card and allow the highlight state to settle
Verify the emphasized sub-span is visibly highlighted
Verify the emphasis appears without a font-weight reflow

title: Toggle a related-card interaction control in place
description: This verifies that clicking a related-card interaction control changes its state without navigating away from the detail view.
category: Related-card topic grouping and navigation guards

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Click a related-card interaction control
Verify the control toggles in place
Verify the current detail view remains unchanged

title: Render a fallback avatar in the reply composer
description: This verifies that the reply composer shows a fallback avatar placeholder when no custom avatar is available in the post detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Verify a reply composer avatar placeholder is visible
Verify the reply composer is present

title: Hover overlapping linked regions without dark compounding
description: This verifies that hovering a related card with overlapping linked regions keeps the highlight shade uniform instead of compounding into a darker overlap.

steps.description: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]
Hover a related card with overlapping linked regions and allow the highlight state to settle
Verify overlapping highlighted areas are displayed
Verify the highlighted areas keep a uniform shade
